### ST-095

**Regression-detection benchmark harness**

*As a **QA engineer**, I want **a harness that injects known regressions into fixtures and checks they're caught**, so that **we can prove selection safety**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S6 | R09, §11.7, G acceptance gate | [ST-005](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-005), [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Each fixture defines ≥ 10 seeded mutations with the tests expected to fail
- [x] Harness runs `run --affected` per mutation and records missed failures
- [x] CI fails if any known reproducible failure is missed

### ST-096

**Performance benchmarks under documented conditions**

*As a **product owner**, I want **reproducible benchmarks for startup, analysis, selection and reports**, so that **our performance claims are honest**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S10 | R01, R02, §31.3 | [ST-047](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-047), [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Benchmark repos (small / medium / large) and reference hardware documented
- [x] Measures warm startup, warm diff analysis, warm selection, report generation, end-to-end savings
- [x] Results published in `benchmarks/RESULTS.md`; targets marked met / not met
